changelog:
JSON Update required for The Herbalist.
- NEW VARIANT: Haven Island - The Herbalist (Sunset)
- Haven Island: Night – Expands target list to include ~62 more NPCs, tweaks some NPCs dramas and removes more story-specific dialogue
- The Herbalist Mission Story should no longer break when (Mandatory) Noodle Massacre addon is deployed (standalone mod will also need update if you have that, best to disable for now)
- Miami: The Undying – Mark Faba can now defend himself with a pistol. He is gone in showdowns.
- Hantu Port: Suspect no longer has badly placed bookworm act at satellite hut, there should be more assassin variety
- Isle of Sgail: Fixes alerted brick causing crash when you don’t have Hantu Port deployed
- Whittleton Creek: Halloween – Removed at request of original creator
- Peacock: Update plugin for new version of Peacock
